externalClaims.gap: Selected published provisions and amendment notes are versioned here. The complete current official codification and subsequent DGE guidance remain unverified; the historical CHAPTER69O PDF alone cannot establish them.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: Official New Jersey codification and the DGE rule index
externalClaims.nextStep: Verify the complete current codification and later DGE guidance through the DGE rule index before relying on this snapshot.

externalClaims.gap: No GLI edition is assumed adopted by DGE. Lab readiness does not establish Division approval; retain the applicable authority and approval records.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: New Jersey Division of Gaming Enforcement
externalClaims.nextStep: Retain the DGE authority and approval records for any GLI edition relied on.

externalClaims.gap: Synthetic or supplied preparation records do not establish an independently verified professional assessment.
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain the independent professional's signed annual assessment, independence evidence and assessor-selection approval for each applicable rule.

externalClaims.gap: Recorded games and releases do not establish independent testing.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: DGE Technical Services Bureau or an approved independent test laboratory
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain or verify the laboratory or Technical Services Bureau results for the deployed game and release versions.

externalClaims.gap: Preparation evidence does not establish DGE approval, and no regulator submission has been performed.
externalClaims.verifiableBy: New Jersey Division of Gaming Enforcement
externalClaims.nextStep: Confirm the Division approval records and the annual submission receipt with the Division.

externalClaims.gap: Customer and operator verification of partner-owned evidence has not been performed.
externalClaims.nextStep: Obtain the operator's confirmation of its partner-owned evidence and integration responsibilities.

limitations: Preparation evidence only. Independent professional, operator and Division verification remain Unverified. No regulator submission has been performed.

requirements.title: Internet gaming annual system integrity and security assessment
requirements.summary: Internet gaming annual system integrity and security assessment
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the independent annual report and all fields required by 13:69O-1.2(q).
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: Casino network annual system integrity and security assessment
requirements.summary: Casino network annual system integrity and security assessment
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the independent annual network report and all fields required by 13:69D-2.4(e).
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: RGS annual system integrity and security assessment
requirements.summary: RGS annual system integrity and security assessment
requirements.applicability: RGS providing content to another Internet gaming operator
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply the independent annual RGS report with the fields incorporated from 13:69O-1.2(q).
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: RGS internal controls and responsibilities
requirements.applicability: RGS providing content to another Internet gaming operator
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply versioned security, operations and accounting controls, change reviews, responsible personnel and Division approval evidence for the controls that require it.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: Approved games and release records
requirements.evidencePrompt: Identify deployed game and release versions, Division approval records, disabled-game notices, and approval evidence for applicable transaction overrides and CDN changes.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: Incident monitoring and notification
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply monitoring and incident records with operator and Division notification evidence, or an evidenced statement of no reportable incidents for this period.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: Transaction reports and distribution
requirements.evidencePrompt: Supply daily game-summary, cumulative pending and void transaction samples, required fields, reconciliation and secure delivery evidence for the casino licensees and Division.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: Operator integration responsibilities
requirements.evidencePrompt: Identify approved operator integrations, agreed void procedures, three-calendar-day issue resolutions, responsibility boundaries and operator evidence.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.

requirements.title: Partner-owned player-account evidence
requirements.applicability: Internet gaming casino licensee or RGS
requirements.evidencePrompt: Identify the operator accountable for player accounts, complaints and patron-data permissions, the integration boundary, and scoped operator-owned evidence. Supplier scans cannot establish partner coverage.
requirements.objectiveBasis: Recorded readiness evidence; this requirement declares no executable objective checks.
